worlds_sandbox_owned_and_expiring.name: worlds_sandbox_owned_and_expiring
worlds_sandbox_owned_and_expiring.value: "worlds"."mode" <> 'sandbox' or ("worlds"."owner_capability_hash" is not null and "worlds"."expires_at" is not null)

organisms_genome_legal.name: organisms_genome_legal
organisms_genome_legal.value: "organisms"."pulse" between 0 and 15 and "organisms"."calm" between 0 and 15 and "organisms"."grit" between 0 and 15 and "organisms"."drift" between 0 and 15 and "organisms"."pulse"+"organisms"."calm"+"organisms"."grit"+"organisms"."drift"=24

organisms_generation_bounds.name: organisms_generation_bounds
organisms_generation_bounds.value: ("organisms"."parent_id" is null and "organisms"."generation"=0 and "organisms"."founder_id"="organisms"."id") or ("organisms"."parent_id" is not null and "organisms"."parent_id"<>"organisms"."id" and "organisms"."founder_id"<>"organisms"."id" and "organisms"."generation" between 1 and 16)

oauth_grants_scope_valid.name: oauth_grants_scope_valid
oauth_grants_scope_valid.value: ("oauth_grants"."purpose"='bot' and "oauth_grants"."channel_id" is null) or ("oauth_grants"."purpose"='broadcaster' and "oauth_grants"."channel_id" is not null)
